title: Python & Data Science Trainer
description:
Python, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science Trainer

**Company:** TECU LEARNS  
**Location:** Kanjirappally, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Work Mode:** On-site  
**Salary:** Based on skills and experience

About TECU LEARNS

TECU LEARNS is a technology training institute focused on delivering industry-oriented education in software development, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, and emerging technologies. We emphasize practical learning, hands-on projects, and career-focused technical training.

We are looking for a passionate and technically skilled **Python, AI & Data Science Trainer** to join our team and help students develop the skills required to succeed in the technology industry.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct practical training sessions in Python programming, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Science.
* Teach Python fundamentals, object-oriented programming, functions, modules, file handling, and exception handling.
* Train students in NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
* Teach data analysis, data cleaning, preprocessing, and visualization.
* Explain Machine Learning algorithms, model training, and model evaluation.
* Introduce students to Generative AI, AI tools, and real-world AI applications.
* Develop assignments, coding exercises, assessments, and practical lab sessions.
* Guide students through real-world projects and portfolio development.
* Prepare lesson plans, course materials, and project-based learning activities.
* Evaluate student progress and provide constructive feedback.
* Keep training content updated with current industry trends and technologies.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of Python programming.
* Good understanding of object-oriented programming and core programming concepts.
* Practical knowledge of NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
* Understanding of Data Science fundamentals and exploratory data analysis.
* Knowledge of statistics and basic mathematics used in Data Science.
* Understanding of Machine Learning algorithms and evaluation techniques.
* Familiarity with Scikit-learn and Jupyter Notebook.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts in a simple and practical manner.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or AI-powered applications.
* Familiarity with TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Knowledge of SQL and database fundamentals.
* Experience building end-to-end Python, AI, or Data Science projects.
* Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
* Experience in teaching, mentoring, or conducting technical training sessions.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electronics, or a related field is preferred.
* Candidates with relevant technical knowledge and practical project experience are encouraged to apply.
* Previous experience as a technical trainer, software developer, or mentor is an advantage.
* Freshers with strong technical skills and a genuine interest in teaching may also apply.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with a growing technology education institute.
* A collaborative and technology-focused working environment.
* Opportunities to contribute to curriculum development and practical training programs.
* Scope to expand expertise in AI and emerging technologies.
* Salary based on qualifications, technical skills, and experience.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed by submitting their updated resume. Please include relevant technical skills, projects, professional experience, and teaching or mentoring experience.

**Join TECU LEARNS and help build the next generation of skilled technology professionals.**

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: AI/ML Internship – Python, Data Science & Generative AI
description:
This program is designed for candidates who want to prepare for **AI Developer / AI Engineer / ML Engineer / Generative AI Developer** roles.

This is NOT a basic Python or introductory AI internship

Candidates should be prepared to learn and work across the **complete AI development stack**. Knowledge of only one or two tools is not sufficient for this career pathway.

COMPLETE AI DEVELOPER SKILL STACK

Candidates will be trained across the following industry-relevant technologies and development areas:

1. Programming & Software Engineering

* Advanced Python
* Object-Oriented Programming
* Data Structures & Algorithms fundamentals
* Exception Handling
* Modular & Production-oriented Python
* Virtual Environments & Package Management
* VS Code / Jupyter / Google Colab
* Debugging & Testing fundamentals

2. Data & Database Engineering

* NumPy
* Pandas
* Data Cleaning & Preprocessing
* Matplotlib & Seaborn
* SQL
* PostgreSQL
* Database fundamentals
* Working with structured and unstructured data

3. Machine Learning

* Scikit-learn
* Supervised & Unsupervised Learning
* Feature Engineering
* Model Selection
* Model Evaluation
* XGBoost / Gradient Boosting
* ML pipelines
* Model interpretation

4. Deep Learning & AI

* PyTorch
* Neural Networks
* CNN
* Computer Vision
* NLP fundamentals
* Transfer Learning
* Model training & evaluation
* Hugging Face ecosystem

5. Generative AI & LLM Engineering

* Generative AI fundamentals
* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Prompt Engineering
* Context Engineering
* OpenAI / Gemini / Claude APIs
* Hugging Face Transformers
* Embeddings
* Tokenization
* Structured Outputs
* Function / Tool Calling
* Local LLMs with Ollama

6. RAG & Vector Intelligence

* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Document processing
* Chunking strategies
* Embeddings
* Semantic Search
* Vector Databases
* FAISS
* ChromaDB
* Pinecone / equivalent vector platforms
* Retrieval evaluation
* RAG optimization

RAG is no longer something we should present as an optional “advanced topic”; it is one of the major patterns used for enterprise GenAI applications.

7. AI Agents & Modern AI Application Development

* AI Agents
* Agentic AI
* Tool Calling
* Multi-step AI workflows
* LangChain
* LangGraph
* LlamaIndex
* Agent memory & state
* MCP fundamentals
* AI automation workflows

This is important because modern AI development is moving beyond simple chatbot/API demonstrations toward **agentic applications and tool-using systems**.

8. AI APIs & Backend Development

* REST APIs
* FastAPI
* API development
* Authentication fundamentals
* Connecting AI models to applications
* Database + AI integration
* AI application backend development

FastAPI is particularly useful here because it connects the Python/AI layer with deployable applications rather than leaving students with notebook-only projects.

9. MLOps / LLMOps

* MLflow
* Model Versioning
* Experiment Tracking
* Model Deployment
* Model Monitoring
* LLM Evaluation
* Prompt / response evaluation
* Logging
* Observability fundamentals
* AI application performance monitoring

10. Deployment & Cloud

* Git
* GitHub
* Docker
* CI/CD fundamentals
* AWS
* Cloud deployment
* AI/ML cloud services
* Model/API deployment
* Basic Kubernetes concepts

Docker, cloud and deployment are critical because an AI Developer needs to move beyond **“my model works in Jupyter”** to **“my AI application can actually be deployed and consumed.”**

11. AI Evaluation, Security & Responsible AI

* LLM evaluation
* Hallucination detection
* Guardrails
* Prompt injection awareness
* Output validation
* Data privacy fundamentals
* AI security basics
* Responsible AI
* Monitoring & error analysis

12. Production-Level AI Projects

Candidates will work on projects that combine multiple components rather than isolated mini-projects.

Examples:

* RAG-based AI applications
* AI chatbots
* AI agents
* Computer Vision applications
* Document Intelligence systems
* LLM-powered applications
* AI APIs using FastAPI
* AI applications connected to databases
* Deployed AI applications
* End-to-end ML/AI projects

THE EXPECTED AI DEVELOPER JOURNEY

The objective is not:

**Python → Certificate → Internship**

Instead, the target is:

**Python → Data → ML → Deep Learning → PyTorch → GenAI → LLMs → RAG → Vector DB → Agents → APIs → MLOps/LLMOps → Docker → Cloud → Deployment → Portfolio → Interview Preparation**

This is the level of technical breadth we want candidates to understand before applying for modern AI Developer-oriented career opportunities.

IMPORTANT FOR APPLICANTS

This opportunity is **not intended for candidates looking only for a short-term certificate or a basic free internship.**

Candidates applying should understand that modern AI Developer roles require a **broad technical foundation**.

If you are looking to build a serious career in AI/ML and are prepared to invest the required time in learning, practical work and projects, you are encouraged to apply.

**This is a career-development/internship pathway and does not guarantee employment or placement.**

Pay: ₹1,000.00 - ₹2,000.00 per month

title: Data Science & Data Analytics Faculty
description:
We are looking for a passionate and knowledgeable **Data Science \& Data Analytics Faculty** to join our academic/training team. The candidate will be responsible for delivering engaging theoretical and practical sessions in Data Science, Data Analytics, Python, SQL, Statistics, Machine Learning, and Data Visualization.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills, and the ability to explain complex concepts in a simple, practical, and industry\-oriented manner.

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver classroom and/or online training in Data Science and Data Analytics.
* Develop and deliver lectures, practical sessions, assignments, quizzes, and projects.
* Teach topics such as:
* Python for Data Science
* SQL and Database Concepts
* Statistics and Probability
* Data Cleaning and Data Preprocessing
* Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
* Pandas, NumPy and Scikit\-learn
* Data Visualization using Power BI/Tableau
* Machine Learning fundamentals
* Regression, Classification and Clustering
* Real\-world Data Analytics projects
* Guide students through hands\-on projects and case studies.
* Prepare course materials, presentations, practical exercises, and assessments.
* Evaluate student performance and provide constructive feedback.
* Mentor students on projects, portfolios, and industry\-oriented skills.
* Stay updated with current Data Science, Analytics, AI, and Machine Learning trends.
* Support students in developing job\-ready technical and analytical skills.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **Python and SQL**.
* Good understanding of **Statistics and Data Analytics**.
* Knowledge of **Machine Learning concepts and algorithms**.
* Experience with **Pandas, NumPy and Scikit\-learn**.
* Knowledge of **Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools**.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to teach technical concepts using practical examples and real\-world datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field**.
* Previous experience as a Data Science/Data Analytics trainer, faculty member, mentor, or industry professional is preferred.
* Industry certifications or relevant professional experience will be an added advantage.

What We Offer

* Professional and collaborative teaching environment.
* Opportunity to work with students and aspiring Data Science professionals.
* Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
